---
title: "experiment_analysis"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
data250fabae <- read.csv("../../01.dataset_filtering/01_A.fabae/final filters/aphis_fabae_data_filtered_4.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = ",") %>%  mutate(genotype = as.factor(genotype)) %>% mutate(session = as.factor(session))
data250fabae$ivip<-as.factor(data250fabae$ivip)
data250fabae <- data250fabae %>% filter(!is.na(ivip))

```

```{r}
data250pisum <- read.csv("../../01.dataset_filtering/02_A.pisum/final filters/acyrthosiphon_pisum_filtered_5.csv", stringsAsFactors = F)
data250pisum$genotype <- as.factor(data250pisum$ivip)
data250pisum <- data250pisum %>% filter(!is.na(ivip))

```

```{r}

model_fabae <- lmer(larvae_total_number ~ ivip + (1 | session/block), data = data250fabae)
anova(model_fabae)
summary(model_fabae)

model_fabae_lm <- lm(larvae_total_number ~ ivip + session/block, data = data250fabae)
anova(model_fabae_lm)
summary(model_fabae_lm)

```

```{r}

model_pisum <- lmer(larvae_total_number ~ ivip + (1 | session/block), data = data250pisum)
anova(model_pisum)
summary(model_pisum)

model_pisum_lm <- lm(larvae_total_number ~ ivip + session/block, data = data250pisum)
anova(model_pisum_lm)
summary(model_pisum_lm)

```
